description: Force arrow looks for rendered overlays (#15150 Z8 review). shaft_radius_m is the arrow shaft radius; min_height_px is the lowest output height at which the style still meets min_shaft_px (the NV-9 legibility floor, #11697). head_span_shaft_radii fixes the arrow head length at that many shaft radii, so a long arrow keeps a slim shaft instead of a long spike. slim is for high-resolution shareable renders.
